title: Proof Scores for Memory-Preserving Agents: A Benchmark Science for Claim Discipline, Evidence Lineage, and NeuroAI Governance
description: Proof Scores for Memory-Preserving Agents proposes a benchmark framework for evaluating research agents by proof behavior rather than answer capability alone. The paper introduces Claim-Score, Evidence-Score, Boundary-Score, Lineage-Score, Promotion-Score, and Notary-Readiness as protocol-candidate metrics for memory-preserving agents that produce research artifacts under evidence, release, lineage, and promotion constraints. The updated seed build maps each metric to a general research-agent risk and includes non-Medina corpus families such as open-source project histories, scientific review packets, clinical-trial summaries, grant drafts, reproducibility packages, and conflicting literature reviews. The archive includes an expanded JSONL seed suite, deterministic scorer checks, expert-panel guide, inter-rater scaffold, baseline protocol, and public-release checklist.
